description: Compute the SHA-256, SHA-1 or SHA-512 hash of a piece of text and return the hex digest. Uses WebCrypto on Hopi's server. SHA-1 is included for compatibility with older systems only and should not be used for anything new. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/hash-generator/
